name: cyberlab-web-server-security-playground
description: Local-only academic vulnerability and mitigation lab

scripts.cert: mkdir -p certs && openssl req -x509 -newkey rsa:2048 -nodes -keyout certs/key.pem -out certs/cert.pem -days 30 -subj '/CN=localhost' -addext 'subjectAltName=DNS:localhost,IP:127.0.0.1'
